about: House recipes, batch 04: written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Vegan Mushroom Ragu with Pappardelle
recipes.summary: A deep, wine-rich mushroom ragu with porcini and thyme over wide ribbons of pasta.
steps: Soak the porcini in 1 cup of boiling water for 15 minutes, then lift out, chop and keep the liquid.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over high heat and cook the mushrooms in two batches for 8 minutes, until deeply browned. Set aside.
Cook the onion for 6 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes. Pour in the wine and bubble until nearly gone.
Return the mushrooms with the porcini, their strained liquid, tomatoes and thyme. Simmer 25 minutes, until rich and thick.
Cook the pasta until al dente, toss through the ragu with a splash of pasta water and finish with parsley.
notes: Vegan. Wine is fine for most vegans but check the label if strict.

recipes.title: Soft Polenta with Slow-Braised Lamb Shoulder
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder braised with red wine and rosemary until it falls apart, served on creamy polenta.
steps: Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Season the lamb well. Brown it in the oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning until deep golden. Remove.
Cook the onion, carrot and garlic in the same pot for 6 minutes, until soft. Stir in the paste for 2 minutes, then add the wine and boil until reduced by half.
Add the tomatoes, rosemary and stock and return the lamb. Cover and braise for 3 hours, until the meat falls from the bone.
Near the end, bring the water and 1 tsp salt to the boil, whisk in the polenta and cook on low for 20 minutes, stirring often, until thick. Beat in the butter.
Shred the lamb into the sauce, spoon over the polenta and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: braise lamb until very tender, well above 75°C.
Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Rosemary Oil Bean and Pasta Soup
recipes.summary: A thick, comforting Italian bean and pasta soup finished with garlicky rosemary oil.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Add the beans and stock and simmer for 10 minutes. Mash about a third of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken.
Add the pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until tender, adding water if too thick.
Warm the second batch of oil with the rosemary and sliced garlic in a small pan for 2 minutes, until fragrant, and spoon it over each bowl.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Cacio e Pepe with Vegetarian Hard Cheese
recipes.summary: Black pepper and vegetarian hard cheese melted into a glossy sauce with starchy pasta water.
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente, saving 1 cup of the cooking water.
Toast the pepper in the butter in a wide pan for 1 minute, until fragrant, then add 1/2 cup of the pasta water.
Add the spaghetti and toss over low heat. Take off the heat and add the cheese in handfuls, tossing and adding splashes of water until the sauce is creamy and clings.
Serve immediately in warm bowls, while the sauce is still glossy and loose.
notes: Use a cheese labelled vegetarian, made without animal rennet.

recipes.title: Eggplant Involtini with Ricotta and Basil
recipes.summary: Grilled eggplant slices rolled around lemony ricotta and baked in tomato sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Brush the eggplant with oil, season and roast on trays for 15 minutes, until soft and golden.
Mix the ricotta, lemon zest, half the basil and the breadcrumbs with salt and pepper.
Spread sauce over a baking dish. Place a spoon of filling on each slice, roll up and set seam side down.
Top with the remaining sauce and mozzarella and bake for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Scatter with basil.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Harissa-Roasted Cauliflower with Herbed Quinoa
recipes.summary: Spicy roasted cauliflower on lemony quinoa with pomegranate and mint, vegan and gluten-free.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the cauliflower with 2 tbsp oil and the harissa on a tray and roast for 25 minutes, until charred and tender.
Simmer the quinoa in the water with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes, until the germ spirals out, then drain and fluff.
Toss the quinoa with the herbs, lemon juice and remaining oil.
Top with the cauliflower, pomegranate and almonds.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Sage Gnocchi Bake
recipes.summary: Roasted pumpkin and gnocchi baked with sage butter, cream and vegetarian hard cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Roast the pumpkin in the oil on a tray for 20 minutes, until tender and caramelised.
Mix the pumpkin and gnocchi in a baking dish. Melt the butter with the sage and garlic for 2 minutes, until the sage crisps, and pour over.
Add the cream, scatter with the cheese and bake for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden.
notes: Vegetarian, using hard cheese labelled vegetarian.

recipes.title: One-Tray Lemon Garlic Barramundi with Potatoes
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned barramundi fillets roasted with lemony potatoes, olives and cherry tomatoes.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes, tomatoes, olives, oil, garlic and half the lemon on a large tray with salt. Roast for 20 minutes, until the potato is golden at the edges.
Nestle in the fish, scatter with oregano and top with the remaining lemon.
Roast for 10 to 12 minutes, until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque throughout and flaking easily (63°C).

recipes.title: Pumpkin and Red Lentil Dal with Coconut
recipes.summary: A creamy, gently spiced dal with pumpkin, coconut milk and a sizzling cumin tadka.
steps: Simmer the lentils, pumpkin, turmeric and water for 20 minutes, stirring often, until the lentils collapse and the pumpkin is soft.
Mash roughly, stir in the coconut milk and salt and warm through.
Heat the ghee in a small pan and fry the cumin seeds, garlic and chilli for 1 to 2 minutes, until the garlic is golden.
Pour the tadka over the dal and serve with rice.
notes: Use oil in place of ghee for vegan.

recipes.title: Achari Paneer Tikka Skewers
recipes.summary: Tangy pickle-spiced paneer and capsicum skewers, grilled until charred at the edges.
steps: Mix the yoghurt, ginger garlic paste, spices, lemon juice, oil and 1 tsp salt. Toss the paneer, capsicum and onion through, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Thread onto skewers, alternating the paneer and vegetables.
Grill, barbecue or roast at 230°C for 12 to 15 minutes, turning often, until charred in spots and the paneer is golden.
Rest the skewers for 2 minutes, until the juices settle, then serve with mint chutney and lemon.
notes: Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Hyderabadi-Style Lamb Biryani
recipes.summary: Spiced lamb layered with saffron rice and fried onions, sealed and steamed in the pot.
steps: Marinate the lamb with the yoghurt, ginger garlic paste, spices and 2 tsp salt for at least 2 hours.
Fry the onions in the oil for 20 minutes, until deep golden and crisp. Lift out, leaving the oil.
Cook the lamb with its marinade and half the onions in a heavy pot with 1/2 cup water on low heat for 40 minutes, until tender.
Boil the rice with the cardamom, cinnamon and bay in salted water for 6 minutes, until 70 percent cooked, and drain.
Layer the rice over the lamb with the herbs, remaining onions and saffron milk. Cover with foil and a tight lid and cook on the lowest heat for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and fluffy.
notes: Food safety: the lamb must be fork-tender and well above 70°C before layering.
Plus 2 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Gobi Aloo (Cauliflower and Potato Dry Curry)
recipes.summary: Tender cauliflower and potato tossed in cumin, turmeric and ginger, vegan and gluten-free.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the cumin seeds for 30 seconds, until sizzling. Add the onion and ginger and cook 5 minutes, until golden.
Add the potato, turmeric and coriander and cook for 5 minutes. Add the cauliflower, tomato, 1/4 cup water and 1 tsp salt.
Cover and cook for 12 minutes, until both vegetables are tender, then uncover and cook until the water has gone.
Stir through the garam masala and coriander.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tamarind Chickpea Chaat Bowls
recipes.summary: Crunchy, tangy street-food chickpea salad with cucumber, tomato, tamarind chutney and yoghurt.
steps: Fry the chickpeas in the oil with the cumin for 5 minutes, until lightly crisp and golden.
Toss with the cucumber, tomato, onion and lime juice.
Spoon into bowls, drizzle with yoghurt and chutney and finish with coriander and chilli.
notes: Use a plant-based yoghurt for vegan.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu with Pork and Sichuan Pepper
recipes.summary: Silky tofu in a fiery, numbing chilli-bean sauce with minced pork and spring onion.

items: 1 tsp Sichuan peppercorn, toasted and ground

steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the pork for 4 minutes, until browned and crisp, then add the doubanjiang, garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add the stock and soy and bring to a simmer. Slide in the tofu and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Mix the cornflour with water and stir in until the sauce thickens and turns glossy.
Finish with the ground Sichuan pepper and spring onion and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince to 75°C or above, with no pink, before the tofu goes in.

recipes.title: Xinjiang-Style Cumin Lamb Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Sliced lamb seared with cumin seed, chilli and onion over very high heat.

items: 2 tbsp cumin seed, lightly toasted and crushed

steps: Toss the lamb with the soy sauce and cornflour and leave 10 minutes.
Heat the oil in a wok over very high heat until smoking. Sear the lamb for 2 minutes without moving, then stir-fry for 2 minutes more, until browned.
Add the cumin, chilli flakes, onion and garlic and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until the onion is charred in places.
Splash in the wine, toss in the spring onions and serve over rice once the lamb is cooked through with no pink.
notes: Food safety: lamb slices are cooked when no pink remains (about 63°C or higher).

recipes.title: Garlic Bok Choy and Shiitake Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Fast, glossy greens and mushrooms in a garlic and oyster-style sauce, vegan with mushroom sauce.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the garlic for 15 seconds, until fragrant but not brown.
Add the shiitake and stir-fry for 2 minutes, until golden.
Add the bok choy, soy sauce, wine and sugar and toss for 2 minutes, until the stems are tender-crisp and the leaves have wilted.
Drizzle with sesame oil and serve with rice.
notes: Vegan. Use tamari for no-gluten and a gluten-free rice wine in place of Shaoxing wine.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Cauliflower with Pineapple
recipes.summary: Crisp-roasted cauliflower tossed in a bright, glossy sweet and sour sauce with pineapple.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the cauliflower with the oil, first tbsp of cornflour and a pinch of salt and roast for 25 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Combine the tomato sauce, vinegar, sugar and soy in a pan and bring to a simmer, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Mix the second cornflour with the water and stir in until the sauce is glossy and thick, about 1 minute.
Add the capsicum and pineapple for 2 minutes, then toss with the cauliflower and scatter with spring onions.
notes: Vegan. Use tamari for no-gluten.

recipes.title: Wonton Noodle Soup with Pork and Prawn
recipes.summary: Delicate pork and prawn wontons in a clear, ginger-scented broth with egg noodles and greens.
steps: Mix the pork, prawn, spring onion, soy, sesame oil, ginger and a pinch of pepper. Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edges and fold into a sealed parcel.
Simmer the stock with the ginger slices for 10 minutes, until fragrant. Season with salt.
Cook the wontons in the simmering stock for 4 minutes, until they float and the filling is cooked through, then lift out.
Boil the noodles and bok choy until tender, about 3 minutes, and divide between bowls. Add the wontons, ladle over broth and finish with pepper.
notes: Food safety: the pork filling must reach 75°C; wontons should float, with opaque prawn.

recipes.title: Tofu and Eggplant Curry in Green Paste
recipes.summary: Creamy green curry with crisp tofu, Asian eggplant and Thai basil, vegan with a vegan paste.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 6 minutes, until golden on all sides. Remove.
In the same pan fry the curry paste for 1 minute, until fragrant, then stir in the coconut milk and stock.
Add the eggplant and simmer for 8 minutes. Add the beans, soy, sugar and lime leaves and cook for 4 minutes, until tender.
Return the tofu, stir in the basil and serve with rice.
notes: Many curry pastes contain shrimp paste, so check the label for vegan.

recipes.title: Pad Krapow Gai (Holy Basil Chicken)
recipes.summary: Fiery minced chicken stir-fried with holy basil, garlic and chilli, topped with a crisp fried egg.
steps: Crush or chop the garlic and chilli together. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and fry the paste for 20 seconds, until fragrant.
Add the chicken and stir-fry for 4 to 5 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through with no pink.
Add the oyster sauce, soy, sugar and fish sauce and toss for 1 minute, then fold in the basil until wilted.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are crisp at the edges and the yolks are runny. Serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: the mince must reach 75°C throughout and the egg whites must be set.

recipes.title: Thai Pumpkin and Coconut Soup
recipes.summary: A velvety, gently spicy pumpkin soup with red curry paste, coconut and lime.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft. Add the curry paste for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin and stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until the pumpkin is very soft.
Blend until smooth, then stir in the coconut milk, lime juice and soy sauce and warm through.
Top with coriander and chilli.
notes: Check the curry paste for shrimp paste if you need it vegan.

recipes.title: Thai Chilli Jam Prawn Stir-Fry
recipes.summary: Juicy prawns, snake beans and capsicum in a sweet, smoky Thai chilli jam sauce.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Stir-fry the prawns for 2 minutes, until just pink and curled, then remove.
Add the garlic, capsicum and beans and stir-fry for 3 minutes, until tender-crisp.
Return the prawns with the chilli jam, fish sauce and lime juice and toss for 1 minute, until coated and glossy.
Fold in the basil and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink and opaque (63°C), so don't overcook them.

recipes.title: Sweet Miso Roasted Eggplant over Rice
recipes.summary: Silky roasted eggplant brushed with sweet miso glaze over rice, with pickled ginger and sesame.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Score the cut sides of the eggplant in a crisscross, brush with oil and roast cut side down for 15 minutes.
Whisk the miso, mirin, sugar and vinegar into a glaze.
Flip the eggplant, brush on the glaze and roast for 10 minutes more, until the flesh is meltingly soft and the glaze is bubbling and lightly charred.
Serve over rice with spring onion, sesame seeds and pickled ginger.
notes: Vegan. Check the miso for gluten-containing grains if you need it no-gluten.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu with Japanese Curry Sauce
recipes.summary: Crumbed chicken breast cutlets served with a mild, glossy Japanese-style curry sauce and rice.
steps: Slice each chicken breast in half horizontally to make thin cutlets. Season, dredge in flour, dip in the egg, then press into the panko.
For the sauce, cook the onion and carrot in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Stir in the second flour and curry powder for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock.
Simmer for 12 minutes, until the carrots are tender and the sauce is thick. Stir in the soy sauce and honey, blend if you like it smooth.
Shallow-fry the cutlets in the 1/2 cup oil in a wide pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until deep golden and cooked through.
Rest, slice and serve over rice with the sauce.
notes: Food safety: the chicken must reach 75°C, with no pink in the middle of the thickest cutlet.

recipes.title: Cold Soba with Sesame, Cucumber and Edamame
recipes.summary: Chilled buckwheat noodles in a nutty soy-sesame dressing with crisp vegetables.
steps: Cook the soba in boiling water for 4 minutes, until tender, adding the edamame in the last minute. Drain and rinse under cold water until cold.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar and tahini into a dressing.
Toss the noodles with the cucumber, spring onions and dressing.
Top with nori and sesame seeds.
notes: Vegan. Many soba noodles contain wheat; choose 100 percent buckwheat for no-gluten.

recipes.title: Salmon Teriyaki with Sesame Greens
recipes.summary: Pan-seared salmon glazed in a homemade teriyaki sauce, served over rice with sesame bok choy.
steps: Mix the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and ginger. Heat the oil in a frying pan and sear the salmon skin side down over medium-high heat for 4 minutes, until the skin is crisp.
Turn the fillets, pour in the sauce and cook for 3 minutes, spooning the sauce over until it has thickened to a glaze and the salmon is just cooked.
Meanwhile steam the bok choy for 3 minutes, until tender, and toss with sesame oil and seeds.
Serve the salmon over rice with the greens.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked at 63°C; it should flake easily with a slightly translucent centre.

recipes.title: Slow-Cooked Beef Barbacoa Tacos
recipes.summary: Chipotle-spiced beef cheeks braised until shreddable and piled into warm tortillas with onion and lime.

items: 1.2kg beef chuck, cut into large chunks

steps: Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan). Blend the chipotle, garlic, lime juice, vinegar, cumin, oregano and 1 tsp salt with the stock.
Put the beef and bay leaves in a Dutch oven, pour over the sauce, cover and braise for 4 hours, until the beef shreds easily.
Shred the meat in the sauce and reduce on the stove for 5 minutes, until glossy.
Warm the tortillas and fill with beef, onion, coriander and a squeeze of lime.
notes: Food safety: beef braised until fork-tender is well past 75°C.

recipes.title: Smoky Kumara and Bean Enchilada Bake
recipes.summary: Soft tortillas filled with spiced sweet potato and black beans, baked under enchilada sauce and cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the sweet potato in the oil and cumin and roast for 20 minutes, until tender and starting to brown.
Mix with the beans, corn and a pinch of salt.
Spread half the sauce in a baking dish. Fill each tortilla with the mixture, roll up and place seam side down. Pour over the rest of the sauce and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Serve with coriander and sour cream.
notes: Vegetarian. Use corn tortillas for no-gluten.

recipes.title: Prawn Ceviche with Mango and Avocado
recipes.summary: Cooked prawns marinated briefly in lime with mango, avocado, red onion and chilli.
steps: Toss the prawns with the lime juice, onion and chilli and marinate in the fridge for 15 minutes, until the onion softens.
Fold in the mango, avocado, cucumber and coriander.
Season with salt and serve with corn chips.
notes: Food safety: use prawns that have been cooked until pink and opaque and kept chilled. Plus 15 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Steak with Crispy Roasted Potatoes
recipes.summary: Seared sirloin sliced over crisp potatoes and drizzled with a punchy parsley and garlic chimichurri.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potatoes with the 3 tbsp oil and salt and roast for 35 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Stir the parsley, oregano, garlic, 1/2 cup oil, vinegar and chilli flakes with 1 tsp salt into a chimichurri. Rest 15 minutes.
Season the steaks and sear in a hot pan for 3 minutes per side for medium-rare, until well browned. Rest for 5 minutes.
Slice the steak and serve with the potatoes and plenty of chimichurri.
notes: Food safety: steak is cooked at 63°C for medium-rare; use a thermometer if unsure. Rest the meat before slicing.

recipes.title: Spiced Chicken Thigh Wraps with Toum and Pickles
recipes.summary: Spice-rubbed chicken thighs roasted until charred, with salad, pickles and toum.
steps: Mix the spices, lemon juice, oil and 1 tsp salt and coat the chicken. Cover and marinate for at least 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 230°C (210°C fan). Roast the chicken on a tray for 25 minutes, until charred in places and cooked through.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Warm the flatbreads and serve with chicken, salad, toum and pickles.
notes: Food safety: the chicken must reach 75°C and the juices must run clear.
Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Spiced Lamb Kofta with Tzatziki
recipes.summary: Juicy lamb skewers with cumin, coriander and mint, served with cool tzatziki and flatbread.
steps: Mix the lamb with the onion, garlic, spices, parsley and salt until sticky. Shape around 8 skewers into long ovals.
Cook on a hot grill or griddle for 10 to 12 minutes, turning, until browned all over and cooked through.
Warm the flatbread and serve the kofta with tzatziki and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: lamb mince must reach 75°C with no pink inside.

recipes.title: Classic Smash Burgers with Pickles and Special Sauce
recipes.summary: Thin, crisp-edged beef patties smashed on a hot pan with melty cheese and tangy sauce.
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, chopped pickle and mustard powder into a sauce.
Divide the mince into 8 loose balls. Heat the oil in a very hot cast-iron pan and smash 2 balls at a time flat with a spatula. Season and cook for 2 minutes, until the edges are crisp and brown.
Flip, top with cheese and cook 1 minute more, until the cheese melts and the beef is cooked through with no pink.
Toast the buns until golden, spread with sauce and stack with onion, lettuce, pickles and two patties.
notes: Food safety: beef mince patties must reach 75°C with no pink inside.

recipes.title: Loaded Potato Skins with Cheddar and Chives
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned baked potato shells filled with cheddar and bacon, topped with sour cream and chives.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake for 55 minutes, until the skin is crisp and a skewer slides in easily.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and keep it for another use. Brush the shells with oil and bake cut side up for 8 minutes, until crisp.
Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake for 6 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Top with sour cream and chives.
notes: Food safety: make sure the bacon is cooked through (crisp) before using.

recipes.title: Vegetable Bibimbap with Gochujang
recipes.summary: Rice bowl topped with seasoned vegetables, a fried egg and spicy gochujang sauce.
steps: Mix the gochujang with 1 tbsp sesame oil, the sugar and 1 tbsp water.
Cook each vegetable separately in a little sesame oil for 2 to 3 minutes until just tender: carrot, zucchini, mushrooms with garlic and soy, and spinach wilted with a pinch of salt.
Fry the eggs in oil until the whites are set and the yolks are runny.
Divide the rice into bowls, arrange the vegetables on top with an egg and gochujang, and mix everything together before eating.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg whites until set.

recipes.title: Korean Fried Chicken with Sweet and Spicy Glaze
recipes.summary: Twice-fried, extra-crisp chicken wings tossed in a sticky gochujang glaze.
steps: Pat the wings dry. Toss in the cornflour, flour and salt to coat well.
Heat 5cm of oil to 160°C in a deep pot. Fry the wings in batches for 10 minutes, until pale golden and cooked through. Drain.
Raise the oil to 190°C and fry the wings again for 3 minutes, until deep golden and very crisp.
Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy, vinegar and garlic for 3 minutes, until syrupy, and toss the wings through. Scatter with sesame.
notes: Food safety: wings must reach 75°C at the thickest part.

recipes.title: Oregano Chicken Drumsticks with Lemon Potatoes
recipes.summary: Chicken pieces and potatoes roasted in lemon, oregano and garlic until crisp and juicy.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the chicken and potato in a large roasting tin with the oil, garlic, lemon juice and zest, oregano and 1 tsp salt.
Pour the stock around the edge and roast for 50 to 60 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is golden and the potatoes are tender.
Rest 5 minutes and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest point, with the juices running clear.

recipes.title: Gigantes Plaki (Baked Greek Butter Beans)
recipes.summary: Butter beans baked in tomato, dill and olive oil until creamy and caramelised.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Cook the onion in half the oil for 6 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and tomato paste for 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomatoes, oregano, sugar and 1 tsp salt, then the beans. Pour into a baking dish and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Bake for 45 minutes, until the sauce is thick and the top is caramelised at the edges.
Scatter with dill and feta and serve with bread.
notes: Skip the feta for vegan.

recipes.title: Chicken Fricassee with Mushrooms and Tarragon
recipes.summary: Tender chicken thighs in a creamy white wine and mushroom sauce with tarragon.
steps: Season the chicken and brown in the butter in a large pan for 4 minutes per side, until golden. Remove.
Cook the onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes, until golden. Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the wine and boil until reduced by half.
Add the stock and return the chicken. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes, until cooked through.
Stir in the cream, tarragon and lemon juice and simmer 3 minutes, until the sauce coats a spoon.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and show no pink.

recipes.title: Ratatouille Tian
recipes.summary: Thin slices of zucchini, eggplant and tomato baked in overlapping spirals over a pepper sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C (160°C fan). Cook the onion, capsicum and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft. Add the tinned tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, until thick.
Spread the sauce in a round baking dish.
Arrange the sliced vegetables in tight overlapping spirals on top, alternating them. Drizzle with oil, scatter with thyme and season.
Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more, until the vegetables are tender and the edges are browned.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Wok-Fried Yellow Noodles with Tofu, Egg and Sambal
recipes.summary: Wok-fried yellow noodles with tofu, egg, bean sprouts and a sweet-spicy sauce.
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and fry the garlic and tofu for 3 minutes, until golden.
Push to the side, crack in the eggs and scramble for 1 minute, until set.
Add the noodles, kecap manis, tomato sauce, sambal and soy and toss for 3 minutes, until the noodles are coated and hot.
Add the bean sprouts and spring onion and toss for 1 minute, until just wilted. Serve with lime.
notes: Food safety: scramble the egg until fully set.

recipes.title: Nasi Lemak with Sambal and Egg
recipes.summary: Coconut rice served with spicy sambal, cucumber, peanuts, boiled egg and crisp anchovies.

items: 1/2 cup anchovy fillets, fried until crisp

steps: Cook the rice with the coconut milk, water, bay leaves and salt in a covered pot over low heat for 18 minutes, until tender and fluffy.
For the sambal, fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Stir in the sambal oelek, tamarind and palm sugar and cook for 5 minutes, until dark and glossy.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, until firm, then peel and halve.
Serve the rice with sambal, egg, cucumber, peanuts and anchovies.
notes: Food safety: eggs boiled until the yolk is firm.

recipes.title: Gado-Gado with Peanut Sauce
recipes.summary: Steamed vegetables, tofu and egg under a rich, tangy peanut sauce, vegetarian and gluten-free.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 12 minutes, until tender. Blanch the beans, sprouts and cabbage in boiling water for 1 to 2 minutes, until bright and crisp-tender.
Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, lime juice, garlic, chilli and hot water until smooth and pourable.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, until firm, peel and halve.
Arrange all the vegetables, tofu and egg on plates, spoon over the sauce and top with prawn crackers.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until the yolk is firm.

recipes.title: Turkish Red Lentil Soup with Chilli Butter
recipes.summary: Smooth red lentil soup with carrot and cumin, finished with sizzling paprika butter.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, tomato paste and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 20 minutes, until the lentils are completely soft.
Blend until smooth and stir in the lemon juice and salt to taste.
Melt the butter until foaming, stir in the paprika and chilli flakes and spoon it over each bowl.
notes: Use olive oil in place of butter for vegan.

recipes.title: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes with Blueberries
recipes.summary: Light, tender pancakes made with ricotta and lemon, served with warm blueberries and honey.
steps: Whisk the ricotta, egg yolks, sugar, lemon zest and juice, flour, baking powder and milk until combined.
Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks and fold them gently through the batter.
Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook 1/4 cup batter per pancake for 2 to 3 minutes each side, until golden and puffed.
Warm the berries with the honey for 3 minutes, until juicy, and spoon over the pancakes.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the centres are set.

recipes.title: Roasted Pumpkin and Lentil Salad with Tahini
recipes.summary: Warm pumpkin, lentils, rocket and toasted seeds with a lemony tahini dressing, vegan and gluten-free.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the pumpkin with the oil, paprika and salt and roast for 30 minutes, until tender and caramelised.
Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes, until tender but holding their shape, and drain.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, water and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Toss the lentils, onion and rocket, top with the pumpkin and seeds and drizzle with the tahini.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Crispy-Skin Salmon with Celery and Orange Salad
recipes.summary: Pan-seared salmon with a crisp skin, served over a fresh orange, celery and mint salad.
steps: Pat the salmon skin dry and season with salt. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat and cook skin side down for 5 minutes, until the skin is crisp.
Turn and cook 2 minutes more, until the salmon is just cooked and flakes easily.
Toss the celery, orange, onion, 2 tbsp oil, lemon juice, mint and capers with a pinch of salt.
Serve the salmon over the salad.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked at 63°C, flaking easily with a slightly translucent centre.

recipes.title: Vegan Chickpea and Spinach Curry
recipes.summary: A quick pantry curry of chickpeas, tomato and spinach in a creamy coconut sauce.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 12 minutes, until thickened.
Add the spinach until wilted, then the lemon juice. Serve with rice.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sicilian Caponata on Toasted Sourdough
recipes.summary: Sweet and sour eggplant stew with capers and olives, piled onto garlicky toast.
steps: Fry the eggplant in 1/4 cup oil in batches over medium-high heat for 8 minutes, until golden and soft. Set aside.
Cook the onion and celery in the remaining oil for 6 minutes. Add the tomatoes, vinegar and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return the eggplant with the capers and olives and cook 5 minutes, until glossy and thick. Stir in the basil.
Toast the sourdough until golden, rub with garlic and top with caponata.
notes: Vegan. Use gluten-free bread for no-gluten.

recipes.title: Farinata (Ligurian Chickpea Flatbread) with Rosemary
recipes.summary: A crisp-edged, custardy chickpea flour flatbread baked in a hot pan with rosemary and olive oil.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water and salt until smooth. Rest 30 minutes, then skim off any foam.
Heat the oven to 250°C (230°C fan) and put a cast-iron pan in to heat for 10 minutes. Add the oil to the pan, swirl, and pour in the batter. Scatter with rosemary.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the edges are deep golden and crisp and the middle is set.
Cut into wedges and finish with pepper.
notes: Plus 30 minutes resting. Vegan and gluten-free.
